methods.label: Magnitude from coordinates
methods.explanation: The magnitude is the nonnegative square root of the sum of the squared coordinates: \(\sqrt{4+9+36}=\sqrt{49}=7\).
methods.levelReason: The spatial magnitude formula, integer squares and an exact square root are within the stated scope.
